scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm paper:test && pnpm gateway:test && pnpm test
scripts.paper:test: uv run --project services/paper --locked python -m unittest discover -s services/paper/tests
scripts.gateway:test: uv run --project services/gateway python -m unittest discover -s services/gateway/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm binary:test && pnpm --recursive test
